extra.message: case_bundle_thaw_171 passes attacker-controlled request body (optionally base64-decoded) directly to pickle.loads(). Pickle deserialization of untrusted data yields arbitrary code execution.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: case_formula_cast_253 evaluates the 'expr' GET parameter with eval(). Even with __builtins__ emptied, Python eval sandbox escapes are well known, allowing remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-95: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')

extra.message: case_jinja_cast_385 builds a Jinja2 Template from the user-supplied 'fragment' GET parameter and renders it. Server-side template injection allows reading secrets and achieving remote code execution via Jinja2 sandbox escapes.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: case_dock_shelf_392 joins the user-controlled 'name' GET parameter onto BASE_EXPORT_DIR with no sanitization and writes the request body to that path. Values like '../../etc/cron.d/x' escape the base directory, giving arbitrary file write.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: case_mongo_lane_414 passes an attacker-controlled JSON body (payload['filter']) directly as the query document to pymongo find_one(). MongoDB operator injection (e.g. {"$gt": ""}) allows data extraction and authentication/authorization bypass.

cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: case_xml_fold_455 parses the raw request body with lxml using load_dtd=True, resolve_entities=True and no_network=False. This enables XML external entity (XXE) expansion, allowing local file disclosure, SSRF and DoS.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: case_banner_fold_016 concatenates the unescaped 'copyline' GET parameter into an HTML string returned with content_type='text/html'. Reflected XSS executes arbitrary script in the victim's browser.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: case_pref_munge_017 applies attacker-supplied JSON keys via workset.update(change_set), letting the caller overwrite privileged fields such as 'role', 'is_admin' and 'credit_limit' (mass assignment / privilege escalation).

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: case_matter_fold_018 returns a hardcoded partner API token ('tok_live_partner_sync') and a hardcoded tax identifier (SSN-like '739-44-1982') in the JSON response. Hardcoded credentials and PII are exposed to any caller passing the ops gate.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

extra.message: case_delta_125 subtracts an attacker-chosen (possibly negative) 'amount' from a ledger balance and copies an attacker-chosen 'state' into the ledger with no validation, permitting balance inflation and arbitrary approval-state forgery.

cwe: CWE-840: Business Logic Errors

extra.message: case_wire_tally_212 logs the full request body and the Authorization (bearer) header at WARNING level. Bearer tokens and request secrets are written to application logs in cleartext.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: case_pulse_spill_346 returns str(exc) and the exception class name to the caller. The exception message embeds the internal absolute export path (BASE_EXPORT_DIR), disclosing server filesystem layout.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: case_identity_hint_364 embeds hardcoded verifier codes ({'north': '4812', 'south': '5930'}) in source as an authentication check. Hardcoded credentials are trivially bypassed once the code is read, and distinct 404/403 responses also allow handle enumeration.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: case_origin_mirror_374 copies the request Origin header into Access-Control-Allow-Origin and sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. Any website can make credentialed cross-origin requests and read responses, enabling cross-site data theft.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains

extra.message: case_nonce_roll_404 generates a security 'code' using random.choice (Mersenne Twister), which is not cryptographically secure. Generated nonces/codes are predictable.

cwe: CWE-338: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)

extra.message: case_frame_slip_424 explicitly disables browser XSS protections (X-XSS-Protection: 0) and empties the Content-Security-Policy header, weakening defense-in-depth against script injection.

cwe: CWE-693: Protection Mechanism Failure

extra.message: case_trust_drift_434 uses ssl._create_unverified_context() for an outbound HTTPS request, disabling certificate and hostname verification and exposing the connection to man-in-the-middle attacks.

cwe: CWE-295: Improper Certificate Validation

extra.message: case_trace_panel_444 returns a 'trace: true' debug payload that discloses the DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE name and the absolute server path of BASE_EXPORT_DIR.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

extra.message: case_crumb_lane_291 sets the 'portal_crumb' cookie from the user-controlled 'marker' parameter without httponly=True or secure=True, leaving the cookie readable by JavaScript and transmissible over plaintext HTTP.

cwe: CWE-1004: Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag

extra.message: _wrk_gate compares the internal ops token with '==', a non-constant-time comparison that leaks prefix-match timing information and may allow the INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN to be recovered byte-by-byte.

cwe: CWE-208: Observable Timing Discrepancy

extra.message: notification_read redirects to the unvalidated POST parameter 'next'. An attacker can supply an absolute URL (e.g. https://evil.example) or protocol-relative URL (//evil.example) and Django's redirect() will send the victim off-site, enabling phishing.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: matter_export (and the sibling deadline/document exports) writes user-controllable fields (matter title, client name, tags, etc.) into CSV cells without neutralizing leading '=', '+', '-' or '@' characters. Opening the export in a spreadsheet executes embedded formulas (CSV/formula injection).

cwe: CWE-1236: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File

extra.message: SECRET_KEY falls back to a hardcoded literal ('dev-only-secret-key-replace-in-production-please-please-please') when DJANGO_SECRET_KEY is unset. Any deployment missing the env var uses a publicly known key, allowing session/CSRF token forgery.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: DEBUG defaults to True when DJANGO_DEBUG is not set ('true' is the fallback). Deployments that forget the variable run with Django debug mode, exposing detailed stack traces, settings and environment data.

cwe: CWE-489: Active Debug Code

extra.message: seed_demo.py (and seed_minimal.py) create admin/attorney/paralegal/client accounts with hardcoded, predictable passwords (e.g. 'AdminPass!234'), and the admin account is promoted to superuser. If seed data reaches a deployed environment, these well-known credentials give full access.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: _client_ip trusts the X-Forwarded-For header unconditionally (no trusted-proxy check). Any client can forge its apparent IP address in the security audit log, undermining audit integrity.

cwe: CWE-348: Use of Less Trusted Source
